caseNameFull: Whitley, Individually and as Assistant Superintendent, Oregon State Penitentiary v. Albers

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 472 U. S. 1007.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Gene B. Mechanic, Esquire, of Portland, Ore., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
